rationale: The agent verified identity correctly and checked the order belongs to the user. However, it made unsupported claims: (1) stating that a single-item cancellation from a pending order is not possible without consulting tools or policy, and offering a swap option also without tool support; (2) asserting the original payment method was a credit card and describing refund rules without checking any payment details via tools. These are fabricated or unsupported by the provided tool results. Although no changes were made without confirmation and the order remained unchanged per the user’s final preference, the unsupported assertions and refusal of a potentially permissible request violate the policy’s requirements to rely on tools and not invent facts. Hence, fail.
